item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video,...

WHY IT MATTERS

OuroWorld successfully bridges static 3D Gaussian Splatting and dynamic 4D generation, enabling complex motion and illumination changes from any viewpoint without explicit masks.
